description: This file defines the DefaultBlockPoolMonitor class, which implements monitoring of block pool memory usage metrics in Orleans streaming. It tracks total, available, claimed, released, and allocated memory, exposing these metrics via counters.

classes.name: DefaultBlockPoolMonitor
classes.description: A monitor for tracking memory usage in block pools within Orleans streaming infrastructure, implementing IBlockPoolMonitor.

methods.name: DefaultBlockPoolMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the monitor with specified dimensions.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Updates total, available, and claimed memory metrics.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Increments the count of released memory.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Increments the count of allocated memory.
